grammar.pattern: V短语 / 主谓短语 + 的 + 名词
grammar.purpose: Identify which item a description refers to
grammar.explanation: 通往村里的路 has a verb phrase modifying 路. 朋友推荐的旅馆 has a subject–predicate phrase 朋友推荐 modifying 旅馆. State 的 before the head noun in these expanded descriptions. A recommendation identifies the hotel; it does not guarantee availability.

examples.zh: 通往村里的路今天开放。
examples.py: tōng wǎng cūn lǐ de lù jīn tiān kāi fàng .
examples.en: The road leading to the village is open today.

examples.zh: 朋友推荐的旅馆还没订。
examples.py: péng you tuī jiàn de lǚ guǎn hái méi dìng .
examples.en: The hotel recommended by the friend is not yet booked.

examples.zh: 我们昨天看过的路线图在这里。
examples.py: wǒ men zuó tiān kàn guò de lù xiàn tú zài zhè lǐ .
examples.en: The route diagram we saw yesterday is here.

commonMistakes.right: 朋友推荐的旅馆还没订。
commonMistakes.why: Use 的 to make the full subject–predicate phrase a modifier of 旅馆.

grammar.pattern: 前一动作作方式 / 后一动作作目的
grammar.purpose: Read how or why the linked actions occur
grammar.explanation: 坐车去村里 links the method 坐车 to going. 去村里了解农业 links going to its purpose. 拿手机查路线 uses holding/using the phone as a means of checking. These share an actor; do not infer that the trip has happened just because its purpose is stated.

examples.py: wǒ zuò chē qù cūn lǐ .
examples.en: I go to the village by vehicle.

examples.py: wǒ men qù cūn lǐ liǎo jiě nóng yè .
examples.en: We go to the village to learn about agriculture.

examples.py: tā ná shǒu jī chá lù xiàn .
examples.en: She uses her phone to check the route.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我们去村里了解农业，所以已经了解了。
commonMistakes.right: 我们去村里了解农业，是说明目的，还没说明完成。
commonMistakes.why: A purpose does not establish that the knowledge has been acquired.

dialogue.title: The route that is open
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the actual destination and transport choice.

lines.zh: 这张路线图是我们昨天看过的吗？
lines.py: zhè zhāng lù xiàn tú shì wǒ men zuó tiān kàn guò de ma ?
lines.en: Is this the route diagram we saw yesterday?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，但西部那条路正在修，通往村里的路今天另走。
lines.py: duì , dàn xī bù nà tiáo lù zhèng zài xiū , tōng wǎng cūn lǐ de lù jīn tiān lìng zǒu .
lines.en: Yes, but the western road is under repair, so we use another road to the village today.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 朋友推荐的旅馆在哪里？
lines.py: péng you tuī jiàn de lǚ guǎn zài nǎ lǐ ?
lines.en: Where is the hotel the friend recommended?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 在地区北部，不是今天集合的中部。地址还要写完整。
lines.py: zài dì qū běi bù , bù shì jīn tiān jí hé de zhōng bù . dì zhǐ hái yào xiě wán zhěng .
lines.en: In the region’s north, not today’s central meeting point; write the full address.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我们坐车去村里了解农业，还是先到城市？
lines.py: wǒ men zuò chē qù cūn lǐ liǎo jiě nóng yè , hái shi xiān dào chéng shì ?
lines.en: Do we take a vehicle to learn about agriculture in the village or go to the city first?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先到城市，再联系主人。前往以前确认当地安排。
lines.py: xiān dào chéng shì , zài lián xì zhǔ rén . qián wǎng yǐ qián què rèn dāng dì ān pái .
lines.en: First reach the city and contact the host; confirm local arrangements before heading out.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 长城照片很好看，但不是集合地。高速公路也不能步行。
lines.py: cháng chéng zhào piān hěn hǎo kàn , dàn bù shì jí hé de . gāo sù gōng lù yě bù néng bù xíng .
lines.en: The Great Wall photograph is lovely, but not the meeting point; the expressway is not for walking either.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 明白，希望这次访问顺利，先问农民能不能拍。
lines.py: míng bái , xī wàng zhè cì fǎng wèn shùn lì , xiān wèn nóng mín néng bù néng pāi .
lines.en: Understood. I hope the visit goes smoothly; ask the farmer before photographing.
lines.speaker: b

choices: Current local confirmation and specific location

reading.title: Method, purpose and place
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 城市和城可以出现在进城、出城的说法里，区与地区需要更具体的地址。
lines.py: chéng shì hé chéng kě yǐ chū xiàn zài jìn chéng , chū chéng de shuō fǎ lǐ , qū yǔ dì qū xū yào gèng jù tǐ de dì zhǐ .
lines.en: 城市 and 城 occur with going into or out of town; district and region need more specific addresses.

lines.zh: 北部、东部、南部、西部与中部是区域位置，不直接等于你面对的方向。
lines.py: běi bù , dōng bù , nán bù , xī bù yǔ zhōng bù shì qū yù wèi zhì , bù zhí jiē děng yú nǐ miàn duì de fāng xiàng .
lines.en: North, east, south, west and central parts are regional positions, not automatically the direction one faces.

lines.zh: 村在南部，农村介绍由当地农民说明，农业情况不代表全国都一样。
lines.py: cūn zài nán bù , nóng cūn jiè shào yóu dāng dì nóng mín shuō míng , nóng yè qíng kuàng bù dài biǎo quán guó dōu yī yàng .
lines.en: The village is in the south; local farmers explain the rural visit, and its agriculture does not represent the whole country.

lines.zh: 中国的首都是北京，长城照片标识地点，但照片不代替开放确认。
lines.py: zhōng guó de shǒu dū shì běi jīng , cháng chéng zhào piān biāo shí dì diǎn , dàn zhào piān bù dài tì kāi fàng què rèn .
lines.en: China’s capital is Beijing; a Great Wall photograph identifies a place but does not replace checking opening status.

lines.zh: 前往村里了解农业说明目的，坐车前往说明方式；路线是否能通行要再问。
lines.py: qián wǎng cūn lǐ liǎo jiě nóng yè shuō míng mù dì , zuò chē qián wǎng shuō míng fāng shì ; lù xiàn shì fǒu néng tōng xíng yào zài wèn .
lines.en: Heading to the village to learn agriculture states purpose; going by vehicle states method; ask whether the route permits passage.

lines.zh: 高速公路、铁路与飞行是不同安排，出发到到达的全部时间另算。
lines.py: gāo sù gōng lù , tiě lù yǔ fēi xíng shì bù tóng ān pái , chū fā dào dào dá de quán bù shí jiān lìng suàn .
lines.en: Expressway, railway and flight involve different arrangements; calculate the full departure-to-arrival interval separately.

lines.zh: 朋友推荐的旅馆还没订，我们昨天看过的路线图也不是今天开放的保证。
lines.py: péng you tuī jiàn de lǚ guǎn hái méi dìng , wǒ men zuó tiān kàn guò de lù xiàn tú yě bù shì jīn tiān kāi fàng de bǎo zhèng .
lines.en: The recommended hotel is not booked, and yesterday’s route map does not guarantee opening today.

lines.zh: 访问以前先联系，表达希望不等于已经确认；拍照与公开都要问。
lines.py: fǎng wèn yǐ qián xiān lián xì , biǎo dá xī wàng bù děng yú yǐ jīng què rèn ; pāi zhào yǔ gōng kāi dōu yào wèn .
lines.en: Contact people before visiting; a hope is not confirmation; ask about photography and publication.
